title: Russian Drone Hits Kyiv-Warsaw Train Near Yahodyn Border Crossing With Poland
detail: Russian forces struck near the Yahodyn-Dorohusk border crossing on Ukraine's western border with Poland on the morning of September 13, damaging a filling station and hitting the locomotive of a passenger train traveling from Kyiv to Warsaw roughly 2 kilometers from the Polish border. No injuries or fatalities were reported on either side of the border; a monitoring group had warned the train crew of the drone threat in advance, and falling drone debris ignited a fire at a nearby gas station and several parked trucks. Border operations were temporarily suspended during the air raid alert. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha called the strike, within 2km of EU/NATO territory, Russian terror 'knocking directly at the doors of the EU and NATO.' Poland's interior ministry said no injuries occurred on the Polish side.

title: Ukraine Strikes TANECO Oil Refinery in Tatarstan, 1,200km From the Border
detail: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the TANECO oil refinery in Nizhnekamsk, Republic of Tatarstan, at around 3:22 a.m. on September 13, with a fire reported in one of the facility's storage tanks. The refinery, roughly 1,200 kilometers from the Ukrainian border, is one of Russia's largest and most advanced, with an annual processing capacity exceeding 16 million tonnes. Ukraine's Center for Countering Disinformation said the plant plays a key role fueling the Russian military, and that strikes on refineries and oil depots directly reduce Russia's capacity to sustain the war. The General Staff separately confirmed additional strikes the same night on Russian oil refining infrastructure in the Kuban region.
